The functional layout favors fluid movement, while modern finishes give a contemporary character to the environment. Property for sale - T4 on the Front Line of the Sea | 230 m² | Matosinhos Sul Living by the sea every day. Between the first and second sea lines of Matosinhos Sul, near Anémona and just a few minutes from Parque da Cidade, lies this extraordinary 4-bedroom apartment, 230 m², situated in the prestigious Portas do Mar Building. Located on the elevated 5th floor, this apartment stands out for its generous areas, brightness and a large south-facing balcony with sea views. The dual solar exposure, South/North, provides natural light throughout the day and its layout allows complete separation between social and private areas. The social area comprises an entrance hall, a large living room with access to the balcony, an independent dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, pantry, laundry room and a guest bathroom. In the private area, the four bedrooms are oriented towards the condominium pool, offering a quieter and more secluded environment. The apartment has two suites, one with a private walk-in closet, and two additional bedrooms served by a full bathroom. In the hallway of the bedrooms there is also a second enclosed closet, reinforcing the excellent storage capacity of the dwelling. The apartment also features two parking spaces and a storage room. Set in a gated community, Portas do Mar Building offers doorman service and 24-hour security, and an outdoor pool exclusive for residents, as well as well-kept common areas. Accessiblities: Location is one of its strongest assets: a short walk from Matosinhos Beach, Anémona, Matosinhos coastlines, Foz do Douro and Leça da Palmeira, very close to Porto City Park and with excellent road access to anywhere in Porto. Restaurants, shops, services, schools and transport are also nearby, allowing a daily life where sea and city meet. Key features: T4 with 230 m² • 5th floor • 2 suites • 3 bathrooms + guest WC • 2 closets • south-facing balcony • sea view • South/North exposure • outdoor pool • 24h security • 2 parking spaces • storage room. A home designed for those seeking space, privacy and the privilege of living on the front line of the sea, in one of the most exclusive locations in Matosinhos Sul. Property for sale - High above Salzburg’s UNESCO-protected Old Town, hidden within nearly two acres of private parkland on the legendary Kapuzinerberg, Paschinger Schlössl stands as one of Europe’s rarest legacy estates. Once home to celebrated author Stefan Zweig, who penned part of his literary masterpieces here, this historic villa offers an extraordinary blend of cultural significance, timeless architecture, and absolute privacy. Surrounded by mature trees and overlooking the baroque skyline and the Salzach River, the meticulously restored residence spans approximately 6,630 sq ft of refined living space, where grand reception rooms, elegant salons, and luminous interiors reflect understated European sophistication. Modern systems have been seamlessly integrated while preserving the soul of the estate. A remarkable approved private tunnel and underground garage project further elevates the property into a category of its own — an unparalleled feature within historic Salzburg. More than a home, Paschinger Schlössl is a once-in-a-generation acquisition for the discerning collector of iconic world properties. Unique opportunity. Exclusively Listed Sale Price: €12,700,000 (agency fees paid by the seller)
